column1: # Snapshot of the MCP toolset registry, taken 2026-08-15.
# WHY: capabilities kept appearing to "spawn" mid-project, and nobody could tell
# whether the surface was actually growing or had simply never been enumerated.
# Every wall that fell on 2026-08-15 turned out to be pre-existing and untested,
# but with no baseline that could only be asserted, not shown.
# HOW TO USE: at session start, run list_toolsets and diff against this file.
#   A new row  = the surface grew; re-read Working-In-Unreal.md's limits.
#   A gone row = something was removed; claims depending on it are now suspect.
# Regenerate and commit whenever it legitimately changes, with a dated note.
# SCOPE, deliberately: toolset-level only, not per-tool. A full per-tool index
# would be ~500 rows and several describe_toolset calls are too large to return
# at all. This catches "a toolset appeared"; it does NOT catch "a tool appeared
# inside an existing toolset". That limitation is the price of it staying cheap
# NOT read wholesale — grep it. Same discipline as Animation-Library-Index.tsv.
